folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B280: full engineering history and selected follow-through
folds.body:
The full original 1–1856-line owner has now been read, including all later receipts, following [B279](#content-reconciliation-b279-earlier-engine-contracts-and-dated-evidence). Preserve its chronology. October 2 packets repeatedly describe schema3 and candidate schema4; later platform/chronicle entries, optional native bindings and coordinated migrations qualify those snapshots. They do not form a single linear migration recipe or assign today's schema. A compatible old envelope, frozen paid outcome and missing-definition refusal remain distinct from a promise to support every historical build.

The mechanical rig and native Weak healing powder formulation are scoped packets, not established deliveries merely because another elder/chronicle consumer uses a resolver. Preserve the rig's actual guard/sidestep/rope choices, separate paid counter, optional untimed manual and prepared idle policy, real stamina and non-HP trial impact. Preserve formulation's exact native recipe/manual alternative, usable finished medicine without recipe knowledge, real ingredients/station/access, failed repeat-craft outputs and XP, and actual regeneration rather than instantaneous healing. Six-minute teaching, same-effect maximum-duration refresh and cancellation forfeiture are proposed local choices. Existing unmarked buffs keep their declared clock behavior; selected bulk-time expiry does not prove bulk healing or whole-game replay.

Power packages separate native XP, local proficiency, source development, acquisition and execution. Continuous improvement can earn supported functions without an unrelated rare faculty or universal rarity ceiling. Preserve the five combination kinds and tier-trigger families; not every advancement needs level plus feat plus chance. Method definitions, particular copies, learned practitioner coverage and external instructions remain distinct. A lost manual need not erase learning, fragments may be mastered within their supported scope, and repeated fragments cannot replay the same receipt. Creator/best-known benchmarks require their stated comparison evidence; an old surpass receipt and current leading status are different claims. No generic skill cap, anatomy, energy fee, copy slot or forced counter follows from the introductory Rat-step example.

The later Village-life delivery qualifies the earlier unimplemented gathering/commission discussion without fulfilling every G-A–G-E proposal. Its actual booklet, optional token handover, home board and recurring meeting are narrow connected consumers. Consuming a token into a retained deed does not prove recipient inventory. A daily optional service answers current availability without paying missed openings; inspection does not enroll a mortal life or retroactively age a save. The earlier guaranteed-sap proposal was explicitly replaced by a common-log route; endpoint expected-tick calculations are illustrations, not measured waits. The native chest delivery later qualifies earlier storage-transfer gaps, while its measured planning reuse is a bounded improvement and does not certify crowded 60fps.

The social/party/profile sections retain useful ownership, informed-witness, directed-memory and life-versus-battle distinctions. A fixed nonlethal elder scene does not establish arbitrary NPC attacks, lethal transfer, generic recruitment/equipment or autonomous rumor/law/karma. Separate known facts supplied to an evaluator from facts discovered by an observer. Recurring scenes need cause/renewal identity rather than repeated menu openings. General scene dispatch remains broader than the bounded chronicle aftermath already reported.

EI1–EI32 and UIE proposals preserve useful consumer seams: actual target identity; local units/law; coherent participant publication; retained time remainder; observer-safe explanation; definition revision; measured caching; and author-to-consumer validation. Registry mounting alone does not prove cross-domain applicability or independent instances. Technical work budgets yield and resume rather than impose fictional power caps. The old 1366×768 targets are historical; changed UI uses current desktop/laptop targets and text settings. UIE13–UIE16 are explicitly hypotheses about a stopped M3 setup, not a proven live diagnosis. The document reuses UIE17–UIE23 for the later renderer proposal after the initial UIE1–UIE12 table, so cite section/date and title as well as code. Round 3's inline improvements and same-day follow-up qualify Round 4's earlier crafting-first wait: an unreserved factory panel and separate preview entry were allowed, capture is limited to observer-safe reads, and import closure gates conversion. Old lane reservations and missing-registry/check statements are historical, as the October 20 qualification already records.

The five deep-engine pilots were subsequently selected by Weibao; their earlier planning-only label cannot cancel that instruction. Selection also does not authorize launching those old chats again. Read the ending receipts before reopening gaps: P3 reports one injected scenario facade with the same lamp success/stale contract headlessly and in a rebuilt browser; P5 reports executable/dormant/native distinctions and exact retained versus future content behavior; P2 reports independent lamplight instances/disposal and direct composition; P4 reports renewed exact-target durable repair and rejected-time preservation. P3's earlier integration failures are not the final combined state: P2 reports the two prior broad failures passing on later inputs. The receipt counts, including P5's 2,373, P2's 2,383 and P4's 2,451 tests, belong to distinct dated inputs. This ending contains no equivalent final P1 receipt, so consult its existing owner for that scope rather than infer failure or completion here. None of these pilots proves whole-game reentrancy/replay, generic reservations/rebase, natural acquisition/pacing or human acceptance. No runtime gate was renewed by this content reconciliation.
